title: Rennova Capture Plan
description: A versioned, server-delivered description of everything that must be collected for a project category. Interpreted by the generic capture runtime in the app. Capture plans are DATA: the MVP and the fully automated future run the same schema, and only the satisfier changes.

version.description: Incremented on every change. A project pins the version it started with and finishes on it.

estimatedMinutes.description: Honest expectation shown to the homeowner before starting, by device tier.

spaces.description: Space types this plan captures. MVP plans address exactly one.

step.description: A group of targets presented as one phase of the flow, e.g. 'Let's look at your bathroom'.

title.description: Homeowner-facing heading. Plain English, no trade terms.

condition.description: Step is skipped entirely when this evaluates false.

target.description: One unit of capture: a photo, a video segment, a scan, a measurement, or a question.

mode.description: What kind of thing is being collected.

requirement.description: REQUIRED targets must be satisfied or explicitly skipped with a reason before the pack can reach grade A.

subject.description: Fact-space reference to what this target concerns, e.g. 'element.bath'.

instruction.description: Homeowner-facing. Imperative, verb-first, plain English, no trade terminology. 'Show us the ceiling.'

hint.description: Optional secondary line. Practical, not explanatory.

illustration.description: Asset key for a diagram showing what is wanted.

rationale.description: INTERNAL AND CONTRACTOR-FACING ONLY. Never shown to the homeowner. Why a contractor needs this. Every target must justify its cost in homeowner effort.

satisfiedBy.description: Mechanisms that can fulfil this target, best first. The evolution hook: adding DETECTION:* or ROOM_SCAN later auto-satisfies targets that a human performs today.

fallback.description: What happens when the preferred satisfier is unavailable or fails. REQUIRE is used sparingly; a homeowner must never be trapped.

producesOpenItemWhenSkipped.description: A skipped target with a reason becomes a stated open item in the pack rather than a silent hole.

guidance.description: Live on-camera direction shown over the viewfinder.

acceptance.description: What counts as satisfying this target. Checks are advisory prompts, never hard blocks.

minLuxWarn.description: Below this, offer the torch and warn before accepting.

question.description: For ANSWER and CONFIRMATION targets. Every question must change price, scope, risk or feasibility, or it must be deleted.

category.description: Asked in this order; commitment escalates.

options.description: Must be mutually exclusive and exhaustive in the homeowner's world. A NOT_SURE option is mandatory on SINGLE_CHOICE questions.

opensOpenItem.description: True for NOT_SURE and similar. Creates a stated open item instead of a guess.

revealsTargets.description: Target ids unlocked by this answer. Escalation: an answer can add questions.

plausibleRange.description: Used to query implausible entries gently, never to reject them.

condition.description: Expression over the fact store, e.g. "element.bath.present == true". Evaluated as facts arrive, so targets appear and disappear as the picture builds.

completenessRules.description: How the pack's A-to-D grade is computed for this plan. The grade must never be inflated.
